reviews.text: Always a very good experience with our Ridgeback. Good consultation and proactive thinking from the vet and all staff; they really listen. Thank you!

Unfortunately, a very disappointing experience at Caressa Centrum Oost.

I had an appointment for my dog ​​Lola's vaccination. Although I understand that emergencies should always take priority, the consultation was interrupted almost immediately due to an emergency. As a result, the actual consultation lasted less than three minutes.

My objection is not directed at the fact that an emergency was given priority, but at the fact that the full consultation fee was subsequently charged. In my opinion, this amount is completely disproportionate to the service actually provided. Moreover, the cost of the consultation was even higher than the cost of the vaccination itself.

What disappoints me most is that, despite acknowledging the exceptional circumstances, the practice showed no willingness whatsoever to reconsider the invoice or offer any compensation. Instead, it was simply stated that the full consultation costs remain due, regardless of the very limited duration of the consultation.

Good animal care requires not only medical expertise but also reasonableness and customer focus. It is precisely these last two that I missed in this situation.

For that reason, I am unfortunately unable to recommend this practice.

I called in fear because my little dog wasn't okay, at 4:00 PM she said you have an appointment! At 2:34 PM she passed away in my arms… I wasn't allowed to come sooner. Chelsea could have offered me an emergency spot.. Sarah has experienced more service from Joyce Hoffman than in all those years with you guys..... Joyce Hoffman sent me a beautiful card. Where you feel absolutely no empathy…………
Very sweet and caring people. I was even allowed to come by to pet my cat!

Hello Melinda,

Thank you for your lovely review! We appreciate you taking the time to review us.

Kind regards,

Caressa Veterinary Clinic Amsterdam Centrum Oost

We were able to get an appointment quickly, and the staff were super sweet and empathetic. The vet also took the time to examine our cat and ask us questions. We were also able to ask questions and received clear answers.
Have been coming here for my 2 cats and my dog for 7 years. Always great care and love for the animals, and profrssional help.
I received good help. The veterinarian was friendly and knowledgeable.
Great vet.. bring your debit card 😉 …
I had my dog ​​neutered. Good care/information beforehand, received clear information after the operation as well, and even called later to ask how the dog was doing. Good service.
this is the first time in 9 years that i've seen my dog lick a vet and not be afraid. Alessandro the italian vet is very kind and professional
Very unfriendly on the phone, NOT helped, no patience with clients, and appointments are NOT kept.
Very friendly, our dog loves coming there and is very close.

I stopped by with my dog ​​today and I am extremely satisfied. Since moving from Drenthe to Amsterdam, I had been looking for a good, but above all kind, vet for my dog. I have finally found one! They really took their time!

Very satisfied. I have been coming here for years, even before it was Caressa. Rob, Loekie, and the assistants always give good advice and have often saved our animals from things like swallowed dental floss and other mischief.
Very satisfied! The avian vet is very knowledgeable. He takes the time for us and for our LêBella, and the ladies at the counter are always friendly and sweet!🦜🍀 …
Great animal clinic. Very friendly and professional. I don't think the clinic is expensive, and it probably depends on what you're looking for.
Good experience with the vets

Very sweet people there. It is a bit on the expensive side though. It would be nice if it became a bit cheaper. Pet insurance doesn't cover everything. Otherwise, no complaints. My 2 dogs have been going there for 4 years. Regards, Toetie and Lady.
Hmmm... I speak a little Dutch... I shared my personal experience in a previous response. Sorry.

Very helpful and professional vets. I like this practice as you stick to the same vet and they get to know your pets without having to always start from the start. Vets are professional and so is the staff very friendly and welcoming.
Fantastic clinic, nice people, compassionate and involved with your animal, good explanation.

10/10!! My dog doesn’t behave great and they always help him very well and manage to calm him. Whenever I have an emergency they always book a spot for me on the day. I am very grateful to all the people that work here and I’ll never go anywhere else 💙 …
Friendly, knowledgeable staff member
I don’t trust anyone else with my cat, perfect service and human interaction with the clients. Your pet is safe here. Amazing doctors and professionals

Absolutely do not go there. I was there last Monday because I suspected our cat might have kidney failure. They took a blood sample with the statement that it would take two days for the results. After two days, nothing, and on the third day, I called myself to see if anything had come in yet. Some of the results were in, but the rest would be available on Monday. They could see, however, that the kidney values ​​were high. If we hadn't called, we would have heard something on Monday, almost a week later. The vet who examined our cat was off duty, but no one thought, "this doesn't look good"; there was absolutely no sense of urgency. Now, on Friday, he is in Amstelveen and his values ​​have risen; I don't think he's going to make it. Every day counts in a situation like this, but not at Caressa; they just let you wait patiently.
Top clinic!

Super nice vets every single time I’ve visited or called for an appointment. The front office staff are sweet and accommodating as well. You can tell everyone there really loves animals and wants to take care of your pet.

Bad experience with my cat! They do not keep good track of the diet prescription…at the desk the assistants can not see the current diet. My cat changed diet so often that there was a big misuderstanding and now he got for months the wrong diet! It starts with a problem and after two years we are not quite there yet! Meanwhile a lot of urinary tests to test if diets work for him or not! Honestly I am not happy at all how this went
Very happy with this practice, knowledgeable and friendly people.

Incompetent staff , incapable of booking a  simple appointment & completely helpful . Make no effort to rectify their error & even call me a liar , accusing me of making a mistake . NOT recommended !!!
There was an acute problem with my cat Kareltje. I was able to come by within 2 hours. That was nice.
Good veterinarians, clear explanation
Very sweet and compassionate veterinary assistants...expert doctors...clear explanation of the situation and the costs...consequences for your pet...what to expect...I am very grateful to you all..
Thank you for the good care!
Professional and very friendly
A great vet! You receive professional and friendly care.
THESE PEOPLE HAVE MADE MY CAT'S ILLNESS WORSE. NEVER GO HERE.

Nice veterinary clinic. Friendly staff.

I also had a very pleasant experience with Dr. Rob during the euthanasia of our oldest cat, Clara. Respectful and friendly.
The last visit with Olive to Dr. Rob was also very nice, and I thought it was sweet that he immediately said Olive was so sociable.
Well informed about allergies and what the treatment plan would be.
Best veterinarian in Amsterdam, definitely better than the other Caressa branches. I feel like they listen better and are less pushy. The staff are always friendly.
Knowledgeable and empathetic on all sides...

I always come here for my cat. Today I had to wait a little longer than usual, but that was fine, no problem. The doctor was very friendly and took her time with my cat. Despite the long wait, I left feeling good, thanks to the friendly staff.

I've been here with four different cats (several times). We had to put one down, and aside from the unpleasantness, it was a very good and pleasant experience (as much as that's possible). Always helpful and friendly service. They're very helpful and take their time. They explain everything clearly and concisely. And they don't push you too hard. Nothing but praise!

Four years later, I am still saddened by taking my parrot Leya to this vet. The treatment was poor and businesslike. When I returned urgently the next day because Leya was having egg-laying difficulties, I stood waiting for another fifteen minutes with a dying bird because no one had time. When Leya passed away during the treatment and I was standing in the treatment room crying, the other staff members were sitting in the next treatment room laughing; I found this very inappropriate. The person behind the counter also had no idea that Leya had passed away. Internal communication at this clinic was/is apparently very poor, and my feeling is that it is clearly only about the money. I will never return here. My feeling is that if Leya had been treated well, she probably would still be with me, but now all I can do is give her urn a kiss every night when I go to sleep 😢.
Lovely staff!
After an unpleasant experience at Ranzijn, I was able to get a second opinion quickly at Caressa. The staff were very friendly and take the necessary care of your four-legged companion!
Dear skilled doctors

Our cats, Pip and Dotje, always receive excellent care here from a wonderful team of specialists. Our cats are happy, and our oldest seems to feel (relatively) comfortable here (which is impressive!). You can always call if you have a question, which is really helpful!

They made a 'little mistake' and gave my cat twice the dose of an epilepsy medication. When I noticed that the side effects were actually very extreme, it took 3 days and multiple calls before the vet finally called me back. Hardly any apology, even though my cat could have suffered serious and permanent damage from this. They only did it because I insisted on a check-up. They took no further responsibility for what they had done.

We brought our service dog for de-worming checks and paperwork before international travel back to the UK.  The team were very efficient, very friendly and the whole service was amazingly good value.  Thank you!
